_note: The boards the installer at /install/ offers: human-curated, one entry per board image. tools/site_versions.py merges this file with the published releases into site/firmware/versions.json (the file the installer reads). `asset` names the release's factory zip of this board ({version} is filled in); `photo` is a file of site/assets/ with its pixel size. To add a board: an entry here, a photo in site/assets/, its own release image.
